log.notes_to_self: Day 1: kill all 11, all afternoon (9 quick, 2 timed). Afternoon preserves night workers, students and people at home: routine pool floor 55,000. Avoid morning quick deaths, which would unnecessarily exclude students. Need learn which 2 of 5 source kinds L cannot access, using pool and successful-trace feedback. Three fully identified accessible kinds plus routine restriction could push pool below 1,000; switch toward inaccessible kinds before that. Hidden cross-reporting can prevent traces or weaken deductions. Initial all-source exploration also builds five-day multiplier (30 deaths =>2x, 40=>4x). No source evidence or access information yet. National kills always safe. Day 1 sources: 2 each North, wire, cable, forum, foreign; 1 national.

Days 1–2: killed all 11 each day, all afternoon (9 quick, 2 timed daily); 22 total deaths/points. Afternoon preserves night workers, students, home routines: 55,000 before source deductions. Continue avoiding other blocks. Each day had 2 each North/wire/cable/forum/foreign and 1 national. No feedback yet beyond initial pool 100,000, traces 0; expect conference after day 2. L cannot access 2 of 5 source kinds; identify those from pool and trace feedback, though feedback is ambiguous. Only 3 accessible kinds, but learning all 3 can bring pool below 1,000 (55,000*.25*.25*.25=859; sector makes it smaller). Cross-reports can weaken deductions or block traces. Need approach cautiously as evidence accumulates. National always source-safe. Build rolling multiplier: 30 deaths in last 5 days doubles all today's kills; 40 quadruples. All 11 tomorrow gives 33 and double day-3 points; all 11 day 4 gives 44 and quadruple. Finishing uncaught has no separate bonus; balance sustainable volume against capture halving accumulated score.

Day 3: kill all 11 in afternoon (10 quick, 1 timed). Total deaths 33; today's 11 score double, bringing total points to 44. Afternoon alone preserves night workers, students, home (55%); never use other blocks. Day-2 conference: pool 10,000 (1 significant figure), successful nonnational traces 5. Likely one source constraint active: sector gives 11,000 or a 25% source gives 13,750, both round to 10,000; cannot identify accessible kinds. L lacks access to exactly 2 of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign. Traces with any inaccessible co-report fail. Only sources reaching 3 successful traces activate constraints, with co-reports weakening deductions. Three accessible source constraints could eventually push below capture threshold 1,000, especially with sector. No new conference today; reassess after day 4. Full volume today builds multiplier: 33 rolling deaths gives double today, all 11 tomorrow gives 44 and quadruple. National always source-safe. Need find sustainable high volume while avoiding third effective source constraint, but feedback currently insufficient to identify which categories to omit. Capture halves accrued score and ends all future earnings; survival itself has no bonus. All days 1-3 used all 11 victims, two per own nonnational source plus national, all afternoon. Await next pool/trace report before changing source mix.

Days 1–4: killed all 11 each day, all in afternoon; 44 total deaths. Day 4 should earn 44 points (rolling deaths reach 40, so all today's kills quadruple), total 88 unless caught. Afternoon preserves night workers, students and home routines: 55% of population. Keep every death in afternoon. Day-2 conference: pool 10,000 rounded, 5 successful nonnational traces. Likely one activated source restriction, but cannot identify which. L cannot access exactly two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign; co-reports involving either inaccessible kind make traces fail. Three successful traces involving a place activate its evidence; unseen co-reports can weaken constraints. All three accessible source constraints eventually risk capture: hard constraints give 859 suspects without sector, 688 with sector. Thus full-volume killing is not sustainable indefinitely. Day-4 conference should arrive tomorrow: inspect pool and cumulative successful traces to decide which sources to omit or whether to pause nonnational kills for safety. With just two hard accessible-source constraints pool remains at least 2,750. National is always source-safe. Need identify inaccessible sources using feedback while avoiding third effective constraint. All prior days used two victims from each nonnational source plus national. Today's entries again all 11 afternoon (10 quick, national timed). Finishing uncaught has no separate value, but capture halves accumulated score and ends future earnings.

Day 5: omit both wire victims; kill other 9 in afternoon. Total deaths through day5=53, points expected124. Afternoon retains night workers/students/home (55% population); never change block. Day2 conference pool10000, successful nonnational traces5; day4 pool10000, traces9. Only rounded pool and aggregate traces known: cannot identify inaccessible kinds reliably. L cannot access exactly two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign; traces involving either fail. Once a place has3 successful traces its associated source-disjunction evidence activates. Three hard accessible constraints put pool below1000 (859 without sector,688 with sector), causing capture and halving all points. We must reduce source diversity rather than blindly kill all11. Current experiment excludes wire, keeping North,cable,forum,foreign plus national (9/day, enough to sustain4x). If sector is accessible and not already activated, this can prevent third constraint indefinitely; if sector inaccessible or already activated, further restriction may be needed. Existing traces remain forever. Inspect day6 conference when provided on day7; a sharp pool decline toward1000 signals need to drop another source, ideally preserve just two accessible constraints. No evidence currently identifies which sources are inaccessible. All earlier days killed11 across all sources; points11,11,22,44. Day5 expected36. Finishing uncaught has no separate value, but preserving future earning opportunities matters.

Day6: kill9, excluding both wire victims; all quick afternoon. Expected points160, total62 deaths. Keep afternoon: compatible routines night workers/students/home total55%; other blocks can shrink pool. Day2 conference pool10000/traces5; day4 pool10000/traces9. Await day6 conference tomorrow. L has exactly2 inaccessible source kinds of5, unknown; traces touching inaccessible kinds fail. >=3 successful traces sharing a place activates source-disjunction evidence. Three fully narrowed accessible kinds plus afternoon routine would imply <=859 suspects (<=688 if sector included), triggering capture and halving points. Actual disjunctions can keep pool larger. Days1-4 killed all11/day, day5-6 omit wire and kill9/day to avoid adding sector evidence; this suffices for40-death rolling threshold and4x scoring. Excluding wire is a hedge, not evidence that sector is accessible. Cannot infer inaccessible kinds from aggregate trace totals alone. Next conference: compare pool/traces; if pool sharply falls, reassess source restriction, though existing evidence never disappears. Goal expected final points, not survival alone; no value to finishing uncaught except avoiding halving and retaining earning days. Cases' major/minor labels have no stated mechanical effect.
